name: Silverymoon
lore:
Silverymoon, the Welcoming City, was a powerful metropolis in the North and the thriving pinnacle of human culture, even amidst the wilderness of the Savage Frontier. Though the Moon prized both education and art, especially music, the Shining Towers also became home to many notable wizards, sorcerers, and other mages, whose traditions came to define the Great Silver Hearth. Its invisible Moonbridge was one such emblematic structure, as it was borne entirely from the Art.

Known to the elves as Homehaven, and translated from ancient Elven as Aerasumé (pronounced: /ˈeɪrɑːsuːˈmɛ/ AY-rah-soo-MEH), the city’s virtues, pursuits, and populace were grandly considered echoes of fabled Myth Drannor. By the mid-to-late 14th century DR, this was largely attributed to the benevolence of Silvertowers’ then-ruler, High Lady Alustriel, who fostered unity between humans and demihumans within her city’s walls. Later in her long rule, the Gem of the North even became the prime signatory state of the League of the Silver Marches and was viewed by many as the capital of the fledgeling nation.

Silverymoon was the largest city in the far lands of the Interior North, and anywhere beyond Waterdeep, but the bend of the River Rauvin split the Gem into two halves, one known as Northbank and the other Southbank. The city once laid entirely on the northern shore, the elder section, and—even after expansion across the Moonbridge—most of its terrain still did. From the shores of the Rauvin, Northbank's walls arced in a half circle to envelop Silverymoon, being pierced by three gates at westerly, northerly, and easterly points, respectively.

subLocations.name: River Rauvin
subLocations.lore: The river that flowed from the [[Rauvin Mountains]] into the [[River Surbrin]], and eventually drained into the [[Dessarin River]] and out to the [[Sea of Swords]].

subLocations.name: Moorgate
subLocations.lore: The western city gate that stood on the [[Dancer's Mask Lane]] and sacred the [[Evermoors]].

subLocations.name: Main Gate
subLocations.lore: The gate that opened onto the [[Moonbridge]] and led into the New Section of Silverymoon.

subLocations.name: Mulgate
subLocations.lore: The easternmost gate into [[Silverymoon]] in the [[Southbank]] and the beginning of the [[Moonway]].

subLocations.name: Hunter's Gate
subLocations.lore: The northern gate of [[Silverymoon]] that led into the city's largest plazas.

subLocations.name: The High Lady's Palace
subLocations.lore: The castle also known as the '''High Palace''' – the seat of power in [[Silverymoon]].

subLocations.name: Star Court
subLocations.lore: [[Silverymoon]]'s government building used for holding courts and assemblies at the [[Halls of Judgment]], record keeping at [[the Rolls]], and many other functions.

subLocations.name: Sundabar Gate
subLocations.lore: The western gate in [[Silverymoon]]'s [[Northbank]].

subLocations.name: Map House
subLocations.lore: Also known as the '''Heralds' House''', a library and repository for geographical maps and genealogies of noble houses. In [[1371 DR]], it became part of the [[Conclave of Silverymoon]].

subLocations.name: Blacklar Gate
subLocations.lore: [[Southbank]]'s westernmost city gate.

subLocations.name: Vault of the Sages
subLocations.lore: A famous library and a part of the [[Conclave of Silverymoon]]. Previously located southeast of the Market in the building later known as the [[ Map House]].

subLocations.name: Garrison barracks
subLocations.lore: [[Silverymoon]]'s garrison barracks by the [[Moorgate]].

subLocations.name: West garrison barracks
subLocations.lore: West garrison barracks of the  [[Silverymooon]] guards.

subLocations.name: Westwatch Tower
subLocations.lore: Also known as the '''Westwatch''', a gate tower adorned with banners depicting past battles.

subLocations.name: Moonwood
subLocations.lore: The forest north of [[Silverymoon]].

subLocations.name: Mielikki's Glade
subLocations.lore: An open-air glade, a shrine, and the land sacred to the deity – [[Mielikki]].

subLocations.name: Silverglen
subLocations.lore: The grove and the shrine dedicated to [[Silvanus]], the Oak-Father.

subLocations.name: Old Wall
subLocations.lore: A collection of streets and buildings that used the city's original walls as part of their structure. The Old Wall encircled the old town from the city docks west of the [[Moonbridge]] and ending at  the harbors south of the [[Market (Silverymoon)|Market]].

subLocations.name: Helvraunur Aviary
subLocations.lore: The [[Helvraunur]] family's aviary filled with all sorts of birds. A [[refuge]] was hidden on the aviary's rooftop, between its crystal dome and the skylight.

subLocations.name: Moonbridge
subLocations.lore: A famous landmark –  magical, invisible bridge across the [[River Rauvin]].

subLocations.name: Bright Blade Brandished
subLocations.lore: A quality tavern beloved by adventurers that stood on the [[Sunset Lane]] and the [[Wallrun]].

subLocations.name: Sunset Lane
subLocations.lore: A short street in the [[Northbank]] where the [[Bright Blade Brandished]] stood.

subLocations.name: Golden Oak
subLocations.lore: A rustic inn famous for its large atrium with a massive living [[oak]] at its center. It stood on the arching [[Dancer's Mask Lane]]. Also functioned as a temple to [[Shiallia]].

subLocations.name: Dancer's Mask Lane
subLocations.lore: The street that began at the [[Moorgate]], and moved northeast and then north in a half circle. It intersected [[Rallowglass Ride]] and the [[Ghostwalk]].

subLocations.name: Dancer's Mask Lane
subLocations.lore: The street that began at the [[Moorgate]], and moved northeast and then north in a half circle. It intersected [[Rallowglass Ride]] and the [[Ghostwalk]].

subLocations.name: Dancer's Mask Lane
subLocations.lore: The street that began at the [[Moorgate]], and moved northeast and then north in a half circle. It intersected [[Rallowglass Ride]] and the [[Ghostwalk]].

subLocations.name: Dancer's Mask Lane
subLocations.lore: The street that began at the [[Moorgate]], and moved northeast and then north in a half circle. It intersected [[Rallowglass Ride]] and the [[Ghostwalk]].

subLocations.name: Ghostwalk
subLocations.lore: Ghostwalk ran west to east for under 500 feet, it began at [[Dancer's Mask Lane]] in the west—across from the [[Golden Oak]] inn—crossed [[Bowshot Ride]] and the [[Moonway]], and ended at the [[Old Wall]].

subLocations.name: Ghostwalk
subLocations.lore: Ghostwalk ran west to east for under 500 feet, it began at [[Dancer's Mask Lane]] in the west—across from the [[Golden Oak]] inn—crossed [[Bowshot Ride]] and the [[Moonway]], and ended at the [[Old Wall]].

subLocations.name: Rallowglass Ride
subLocations.lore: The street ran from the the large east-west street known as [[Many Cats Lane]] down to the Docks in the west side of [[Northbank]], crossing [[Dancer's Mask Lane]] along the way.

subLocations.name: Rallowglass Ride
subLocations.lore: The street ran from the the large east-west street known as [[Many Cats Lane]] down to the Docks in the west side of [[Northbank]], crossing [[Dancer's Mask Lane]] along the way.

subLocations.name: Many Cats Lane
subLocations.lore: A wide road that crossed [[Silverymoon]] from east to west.

subLocations.name: Many Cats Lane
subLocations.lore: A wide road that crossed [[Silverymoon]] from east to west.

subLocations.name: Helmer's Wall
subLocations.lore: A quality tavern that had its structure built upon a part of the [[Old Wall]]. The establishment was frequented by students of many [[Silvaeren]] colleges.

subLocations.name: Moonway
subLocations.lore: The long street that began at the [[Mulgate]], ran north along the [[Moonbridge]], and ending at the [[Ghostwalk (street)|Ghostwalk]].

subLocations.name: Moonway
subLocations.lore: The long street that began at the [[Mulgate]], ran north along the [[Moonbridge]], and ending at the [[Ghostwalk (street)|Ghostwalk]].

subLocations.name: Brightbuckler Street
subLocations.lore: A relatively short 100 yard street that began at the [[River Rauvin]], east of the [[Moonbridge]], and headed north. It then bent to the west and merged into the [[Moonway]].

subLocations.name: Bowshot Ride
subLocations.lore: The street that ran from the Docks to the [[Old Wall]]'s gatehouse, later tavern, of [[Helmer's Wall]].

subLocations.name: The Hammer and the Helm
subLocations.lore: A [[dwarf|dwarven]]-only tavern that welcomed females of all races and those whom dwarves considered to be their "swordbrothers."

subLocations.name: A Handful of Stars
subLocations.lore: A shop operated by the [[Selûnite]]s that dealt in navigation tool and nautical maps of all sorts.

subLocations.name: Shadowstars Lane
subLocations.lore: A street in [[Northbank]] that began behind the first row of buildings on the northern, side of the [[Many Cats Lane]], then moved and curved north.

subLocations.name: Wayward House
subLocations.lore: Formerly the '''[[Inn of the Wayward Sages]]''' on the northwestern side of the crossing of the Ghostwalk and [[Bowshot Ride]].

subLocations.name: The Stagstand
subLocations.lore: An antler and war-banner themed tavern that served as a fanciful eatery and a dancehall.

subLocations.name: The House Invincible
subLocations.lore: [[Silverymoon]]'s temple of [[Helm]].

subLocations.name: Rhyester's Matins
subLocations.lore: Previously known as '''Lathander's Dawn''', a major temple to [[Lathander]].

subLocations.name: Temple of Silver Stars
subLocations.lore: A major temple of [[Selûne]] that stood east across from the [[Halls of Inspiration]].

subLocations.name: Halls of Inspiration
subLocations.lore: The temple dedicated to the deities [[Oghma]] and [[Milil]].

subLocations.name: Everdusk Hall
subLocations.lore: A shrine dedicated to [[elven]] gods. It was burned down in [[1347 DR]] but later rebuilt. By [[1372 DR]], the temple held elven poetry, genealogies, records, philosophies, as  well as worship of the [[Seldarine]].

subLocations.name: The Market
subLocations.lore: A large open plaza where merchants sold their wares. A very popular area during warmer months of the year.

subLocations.name: Shining Scroll
subLocations.lore: The long and narrow three-story high shop that dealt in magical goods, spell [[scroll]]s and [[potion]]s.

subLocations.name: Dancing Goat
subLocations.lore: A bawdy tavern with busy dance floor and private upstairs rooms. After it burned down sometime after [[1372 DR]], the new establishment was named '''[[Son of the Goat]]''' and continued Dancing Goat's legacy of revels.

subLocations.name: Auchtareen Lane
subLocations.lore: The street that began at [[Blacklar Gate]] and moved northeast.

subLocations.name: Sorlar's Smiling Satyr
subLocations.lore: A new tavern as of [[1372 DR]], notable for its stained glass, fanciful curtains, and odd stairs.

subLocations.name: Optym's Blade
subLocations.lore: A superb arms shop that sold a wide variety of weapons but specialized in [[axe]]s.

subLocations.name: Sundabar Commons
subLocations.lore: Also known as ''Sundabar Court''' – facilities dedicated to caravan trade by the [[Sundabar Gate]].

subLocations.name: Temple of Tymora
subLocations.lore: The temple dedicated to the goddess of luck – [[Tymora]].

subLocations.name: Tower of Balance
subLocations.lore: The temple dedicated to the Mother of All Magic – [[Mystra]].

subLocations.name: Highaxe Lane
subLocations.lore: A small street that split from [[Dancer's Mask Lane]], close to its northern end.

subLocations.name: Vilriel's Shop of Useful Items
subLocations.lore: A miscellany store that dealt in general goods.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Moonbridge Boat Rentals
subLocations.lore: A local rental shop that dealt in small-sized boats.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Inn of the Downstream Run
subLocations.lore: A riverside inn of note on the [[Northbank]], famed for its scented floating ''[[driftglobe]]s''.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Padrumm's Armory
subLocations.lore: An [[armor]] merchant of note.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Broadband's Forge and Tack Shop
subLocations.lore: A blacksmith's shop that hid a shrine to [[Bane]], the Lord of Tyranny, past a secret door in the back.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Hall of Training
subLocations.lore: [[Silverymoon]]'s hall that offered training in the art of combat.{{approx}}

subLocations.name: Shrine to Finder Wyvernspur
subLocations.lore: The home of [[Laraelna Bowdragon]], a late 15{{th}} century [[DR]] retired [[adventurer]] with a guarded shrine to her [[god]], [[Finder]], located in the cellar .

subLocations.name: College of Fochlucan
subLocations.lore: The famous [[bardic]] college that was reopened as the [[House of the Harp]] after being abandoned for over a century. By [[1372 DR]], the college was reopened under the name of Fochlucan.

subLocations.name: Utrumm's Music Conservatory
subLocations.lore: The famed school of music in [[Silverymoon]] and a member institution of the [[Conclave of Silverymoon]].

subLocations.name: Lady's College
subLocations.lore: The first open school for [[mage]]s in Silverymoon and the heart of the [[Conclave of Silverymoon]].

subLocations.name: Arkhen's Invocatorium
subLocations.lore: A college of magic in [[Silverymoon]] that specialized in [[sorcery]] and was a part of the [[Conclave of Silverymoon]]. Previously, it stood on the east side of city.

subLocations.name: Miresk's School of Thaumaturgy
subLocations.lore: A school of [[magic]] in [[Silverymoon]] and a shop that traded in [[enchanted]] items; a founding member institution of the [[Conclave of Silverymoon]].
